_frozen_why: Vung chua con so hang cho da cong bo (30 - 90 min; 30 to 50 / 60 to 90). Luat 5 skill me: quy trinh thang khong dung vao con so.
hero-bullet: Priority immigration lane — past the 60–90 minute winter-charter queue
peak-body: Cam Ranh is a small terminal serving big aircraft — Vietjet's new Moscow route, flying three times a week since 23 September, lands a 370-seat jet. The winter charter season opens with the new schedule on 25 October, so the T2 hall fills within minutes — 30 to 50 minutes on a normal busy day, 60 to 90 at the peak.
faq-night: A large share of flights at Cam Ranh falls in these hours — eight land between 22:30 and midnight, and the Russian charters start at 04:00. We operate 24/7 regardless of flight time.
